text:
alex: quick heads-up  we saw an anomalous spike in token counts for the 2026-05-02 03:00-04:30Z window. estimated ~140 customers impacted. this looks like a late dedupe regression after yesterday's rollback. need owners and a short playbook for recovery.
dina: triage summary: the dedupe patch reverted an op that prevented replays from being flagged; during a consumer rebalance duplicates slipped through. infra added a temporary block at 03:15Z.
rahul: i'm putting together a recovery job to calculate net-token deltas and a small tool to generate CSVs for finance import. ETA 6h dry-run. sample command: ```./recover_tokens --window "2026-05-02T03:00Z/2026-05-02T04:30Z" --dry-run```
billing-bot: FIN-5233 created: "Billing recovery: dedupe regression -> credits & corrections" (assignees: rahul, dina, alex). Priority: P1. Linked: INC-2026-0502.
ops-runner: containment: blocked the legacy replay path at 03:22Z and added an ad-hoc alert on duplicate-emits > 50/min. rolling canary for dedupe-fix at 19:00Z tonight.
dina: proposed short playbook: 1) Confirm root cause & fix canary (owner: rahul) due: 2026-05-02T19:30Z. 2) Run recovery dry-run (owner: rahul) due: 2026-05-02T09:00Z. 3) Produce finance CSV and provisional credit amounts (owner: alex) due: 2026-05-02T12:00Z. 4) Apply provisional credits for custs with net_delta > 0 (owner: alex) due: 2026-05-02T15:00Z. 5) After final run, post invoice corrections (owner: billing ops) due: 2026-05-03T18:00Z. 6) Postmortem + recurrence checklist (owner: dina) due: 2026-05-07. please ack or reassign.
rahul: ack. plan for dedupe-fix: add a durable processed-event fingerprint store and stricter ordering checks; unit + integration tests added. canary will report consumer-lag and duplicate-emits.
alex: finance note: provisional credit policy same as previous incidents. need CSV columns: customer_id, invoice_id, orig_tokens, recovered_tokens, credit_amount_cents, action. I'll coordinate with billing ops for ledger entries.
qa-metering: please include tests that simulate consumer rebalance during spike. tagging qa-metering for priority regression test.
ops-runner: monitoring followups: add alert rule: `duplicate_emits_rate > 30 for 5m` AND `consumer_rebalance_count > 1` -> paging. also added dashboard tile for `dedupe.failures`.
dina: communications: draft for support/customers: short explanation + timeline + what were doing. alex will scrub amounts before send.
rahul: dry-run completed: 136 affected customers in staging. pushing CSV to FIN-5233 artifacts now: /artifacts/fin5233/recover-dryrun-0502.csv
alex: received CSV, will compute provisional credits and create ledger entries after cross-check.
dina: owners confirmed in-thread. i'll own the postmortem and recurrence mitigations. updating FIN-5233 as tasks progress. thanks :white_check_mark:
